paper_title: On the Role of Model Prior in Real-World Inductive Reasoning
caption: Human pairwise comparison results on three datasets, showing preferences for hypotheses with, without demos, and cases where it was hard to tell the difference.
model_annotation: This pie chart visually represents human preferences across three datasets related to hypotheses with and without demos, and instances where differences were difficult to discern. The chart comprises three pie charts, each representing a dataset, for a total of three charts and six categories. Each dataset's pie chart displays three categories: "W/ Demos" (light blue), "Hard to Tell" (teal), and "Truthful Review" (dark blue). Percentages are indicated directly within each slice. In the first dataset, "Truthful Review" holds 43.0%, "Hard to Tell" is 22.9%, and "W/ Demos" represents 34.1%. In the second dataset, "Funny Reddit" holds 41.5%, "W/ Demos" is 21.5%, and "Hard to Tell" is 37.1%. Lastly, the third dataset shows "Unhealthy Comments" occupying 34.8%, "W/ Demos" with 27.4%, and "Hard to Tell" with 37.8%. The categories for each dataset's pie chart appear visually ordered from largest to smallest slice. A legend is not present, but each slice includes a percentage label.
